articles.title: Candidate for Massachusetts lieutenant governor suspends campaign after car crash
articles.description: The Republican candidate for lieutenant governor in Massachusetts has dropped out of the race hours after he was arrested in a suspected drunk driving crash. Shawn Oliver, a city councilor in New Bedford, said in a post on X on Sunday that he was ending his campaign. Republican gubernatorial candidate Mike Minogue said he asked Oliver to suspend his campaign. Police say Oliver was arrested after a car crash late Saturday on suspicion of operating under the influence of alcohol. A phone message was left for Oliver.
